1. GEAR UP
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
A motion by Sarver was seconded by Ball to approve the Assistant Superintendent of Accelerated Learning's recommendation to partner with the University of Kansas to participate in the GEAR UP federal grant competition. 

A discussion was held and Dr. Casey made a presentation.  The board also heard from Cory Hall with University of Kansas.   

The motion carried 5-1-1.
